picks.editorial_note: A Fermilab-led team was selected under DOE's new Genesis Mission to build AI systems that control particle accelerators, marking a significant national investment in AI for fundamental physics infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: The world's first trial of AI-driven flightpath adjustments to cut aviation's climate impact is a landmark real-world test of AI for climate mitigation, backed by a UK government-funded, Google-led consortium.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on over $42 million in NSF grants to build national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure, a major investment supporting AI research capacity across many institutions.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are pairing AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate discovery of new battery materials, a concrete example of AI-driven materials science with industry backing.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $9 million NSF-funded iDLab, built by NCSA and UCLA, will unify browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly supporting the national AI research infrastructure (NAIRR) push.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs from large-scale training often can't be traced to specific source data — has important implications for AI copyright and provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital's joint AI Data Infrastructure Lab tackles the storage bottlenecks underlying growing AI data demands, a notable industry-academia response to AI infrastructure strain.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation

picks.editorial_note: An AI-powered digital twin developed by Old Dominion University researchers was validated in real time during actual flooding in Norfolk, demonstrating tangible operational value for AI-driven coastal disaster response.
picks.title: When Norfolk Flooded, ODU Coastal Defense Research Faced an Unexpected Real-World Test

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and Smith+Nephew launched a five-year center to translate AI and computer-vision research into surgical robotics, a substantial academia-industry bet on AI in medical devices.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo formed a dedicated research cluster combining an AI drug-discovery platform with biomedical expertise, an industry-academia structure aimed at accelerating pharmaceutical AI applications.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo
